entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So the Phantom Thieves only stole[n]the heart of Futaba Sakura?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And Medjed was in turn defeated by her[n]real-world hacking abilities?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This does correlate to the facts as we[n]know them...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If he's telling the truth, then Wakaba[n]Isshiki didn't commit suicide...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Did a third party target her life with the[n]goal of destroying her research?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Wakaba's death was two years ago...[n]That also coincides with when the[n]incidents started occurring...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Does this other Metaverse user that[n]Madarame and Kaneshiro mentioned...[n]really exist?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Earlier, I briefly mentioned about those[n]psychotic breakdown incidents that have[n]alarmed the public.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: All of a sudden, people will lose[n]consciousness or become violent...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: A situation as incomprehensible as that[n]can't be explained away as "troubled[n]social conditions."

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...I suspect that these cases are all[n]connected to a larger, man-made plot.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The method involved always muddled[n]the explication, but your story has[n]virtually confirmed its viability.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Although, I wouldn't have expected[n]a new criminal to come to light from[n]your testimony...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What did your group think of this other[n]Metaverse user?
The true criminal.
Not so different from us.
Unimportant.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: How self-centered of you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves tamper with[n]people's hearts without asking consent.[n]How is that different?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So you were aware that what you were[n]doing wasn't the pure justice you[n]envisioned?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Are you saying it didn't matter to you that[n]complete strangers were being victimized?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Well... no matter how you thought of[n]them, there can be no doubting your[n]resolve.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Are those incidents because of you or[n]someone else? Either way, I will get to[n]the bottom of this.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Now, let's move on to your next crime.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Kunikazu Okumura...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You should know who he is.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Considering what happened.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Your testimony regarding this incident[n]will be serious. I'm sure you understand[n]why.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Answer my next question carefully.[n]What did you do to this Okumura?
I feel like my bond with Sae[n]is growing deeper...
